nav.settingsTitle: Settings: folders, language, AI agent, ComfyUI

topbar.pathPlaceholder: Photo path (JPEG / PNG / TIFF / HEIC), e.g. D:\Photos\IMG_0001.jpg
topbar.gridTitle: Grid: browse the photo folder, multi-select, copy / paste edits, export the selection
topbar.carryHint: Carried over from the previous photo (not this photo's edit yet; it carries on to the next one)
topbar.resetAllTitle: Reset all tweaks: set every tweak back to zero (back to preset × strength)
topbar.resetOriginalTitle: Back to original: remove the preset and every tweak (Ctrl+Z brings it back; later, use "Bring back previous")

status.updatedDetail: Preview updated: backend {{backend}} ms, round trip {{roundTrip}} ms

caps.title: Features
caps.buttonTitle: Features: which ones are available and why some are off
caps.refreshTitle: Detect GPU, HEIC, WebP, photo library, preset library, semantic index, 1Password, ComfyUI and AI agent again

presets.importTitle: Import xmp: pick one or more .xmp files to copy into the preset library (the originals are not touched)
presets.favEmpty: No favorites yet; press ☆ next to a preset to add one
presets.rowMenu: Actions: rename, move to…, new group
presets.flagMajor: Some settings that change the look cannot be applied
presets.flagMinor: Some detail settings (noise reduction, sharpening detail…) are not applied
presets.downloadTooMany: This group has {{n}} presets; at most 500 can be downloaded at once. Download its sub-groups first

prompt.renameGroup: New name of the group (full path)

editor.resetKey: Reset this tweak (back to preset × strength)
editor.curveNone: This preset has no point curve
editor.holdTitle: Hold to see the original (shortcut: hold \)
editor.compareTitle: Compare: original on the left, edited on the right; drag the divider (shortcut: Y)
editor.cropTitle: Crop: drag the box, pick a ratio, straighten, rotate, flip (shortcut: R; Enter done, Esc cancel)
editor.empty: Type a photo path above and press "Open"
editor.restorePreviousTitle: Bring back previous: restore the edit that was last reset (cleared)
editor.savePresetTitle: Save the current preset × strength + tweaks as your own preset (the current edit is not changed)
editor.exportTitle: Export: open the export settings (format, size, metadata, sharpening); Enter exports full resolution as a new file in the "darkroom 匯出" folder next to the photo
editor.skipDetail: Settings that cannot be applied (full text)
editor.presetChanged: The preset has changed; this edit uses the preset snapshot taken back then
editor.presetMissing: The preset is no longer in the library; this edit uses the preset snapshot taken back then
editor.editUnreadable: Could not read the saved edit: changes to this photo are not autosaved for now (so the saved crop and colours are not overwritten). Please open the photo again
editor.resetToast: Back to original (Ctrl+Z brings it back)

crop.label: Crop
crop.hint: Drag the box or its handles; Enter done, Esc cancel
crop.abDisabled: Compare is not available while cropping; finish or cancel first
crop.resetTitle: Reset: no crop, no straightening, no rotation (Ctrl+Z brings it back)
crop.box: Crop box (drag to move; arrow keys 0.5%, Shift 5%)

grid.loadTitle: List the photos in this folder

filterTitle.edited: Show only photos with an edit
filterTitle.plain: Show only photos without an edit

grid.copyEditTitle: Copy the current photo's edit (preset snapshot, strength, tweaks)
grid.pasteEditTitle: Paste the copied edit onto the selected photos, replacing their colours (each keeps its own crop and rotation unless the option next to this is ticked)
grid.pasteGeometryTitle: Also replace the crop and rotation of the selected photos when pasting
grid.resetOriginalTitle: Back to original: remove the edits of the selected photos ("Bring back previous" restores them)
grid.restoreTitle: Bring back previous: put back the edit last cleared from each selected photo
grid.exportSelectedTitle: Export the selected photos at full resolution, each with its own saved edit (opens the export settings first)
grid.empty: This folder has no supported photos (JPEG / PNG / TIFF / HEIC)
grid.pasteConfirm: Replace the edits of {{n}} photos with the edit of {{name}}?
grid.resetConfirm: Set {{n}} photos back to the original? ("Bring back previous" restores them)

export.title: Export
export.presetTitle: Apply a saved set of export settings
export.saveAsTitle: Save the current settings as an export preset (the same name replaces it; can be undone)
export.deleteTitle: Delete the selected export preset (can be undone)
export.bitDepthTitle: Bit depth: JPEG / WebP are 8-bit only
export.maxKbTitle: JPEG file size limit (KB, 1 KB = 1024 bytes)
export.metadataTitle: Which EXIF goes with the file
export.presetNamePrompt: Export preset name (1–60 characters; the same name replaces it, can be undone)
export.presetDeleteConfirm: Delete the export preset "{{name}}"? Afterwards you can press "Undo" in the message, or save it again

settings.title: Settings
settings.configFileNone: No settings file yet (it is created when you apply)
settings.unavailable: The backend does not offer the settings API yet ({{reason}}); edit config.local.json for now
settings.cliPinned: Given on the command line for this run (--preset-dir / --data-dir); a change here is written to the settings file and takes effect the next time darkroom starts without that flag
settings.pendingRestart: Written to the settings file; takes effect the next time darkroom starts without the command-line flag: {{keys}}
settings.envReadOnly: Set by an environment variable; change the environment variable to change it

help.language: Interface language, switches right away; backend error sentences are shown as they are
help.preset_dir: The folder with your Lightroom .xmp presets (sub-folders are fine); darkroom only reads it
help.preset_library_dir: The preset library's index, imports and saved presets live here; empty = the parent of the preset folder
help.data_dir: Edits and thumbnail cache of the photo library; empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%\darkroom
help.localllms_root: Where the models and runtimes are (optional)

agent.api_key_ref: Only a 1Password reference, e.g. op://Private/Anthropic/credential; read with op read when needed and kept in memory only
agent.model: The Claude model used by the semantic index and other agent work
agent.budget_usd: Spending cap of one semantic index build; above it nothing is sent

help.calibration_sources_dir: Folder of the 4 public calibration photos for the semantic index (only those 4 file names are read)

settings.keyNotStored: The key is never stored in the settings file: only the 1Password reference is

transfer.exportTitle: Save the current settings as a JSON file (never the key itself)
transfer.importTitle: Read a settings JSON, see what it would change, then decide
transfer.badFile: This is not a darkroom settings file (format must be darkroom-settings/1)
transfer.previewNone: This file matches the current settings; nothing to change

errors.secretRef: Only a 1Password reference (op://vault/item/field); never paste the key itself

explain.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported photo format (JPEG / PNG / TIFF / HEIC only)
explain.unknownImage: The photo is no longer in memory; please open it again
